description: This file defines a Perl class Coocook::View::Ajax that extends Catalyst::View::JSON to handle AJAX responses in JSON format, with custom rendering logic for empty responses.

classes.name: Coocook::View::Ajax
classes.description: A view class for handling AJAX responses in JSON format within the Coocook application, extending Catalyst::View::JSON.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Overrides the default render method to handle cases where data is undefined, removing the Content-Type header and returning an empty string, or otherwise dumping the data as JSON.
